projects.title: Lemiki
projects.description: A tiny pet (cat, dog, rabbit, hamster or pigeon) that lives on your desktop and reacts to your builds, tests and typing, so coding feels a little less lonely.

projects.title: Carnet
projects.description: Merge, reorder, compress and convert PDFs, Word documents and images right on your PC, so private files never have to be uploaded to a website.

projects.title: Copiamo
projects.description: A Windows clipboard with a memory: it keeps everything you copy, cut and paste with where it came from and where it went, so nothing you copied is ever lost.
